overall: The AG found the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by withholding minutes of a November 4, 2021 executive session that did not fall under any permissible purpose, and ordered release of those minutes unredacted.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the State Rehabilitation Council improperly withheld minutes of executive sessions with HMA and its DEI workgroup, including a November 4, 2021 session.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by improperly withholding executive session meeting minutes.

allegations.summary: The Council argued the November 4, 2021 DEI workgroup session was sensitive and confidential, so minutes could be withheld; the AG examined whether any executive session purpose applied.
allegations.key_passage: After review of the minutes of the November 4 executive session, we find that the discussions did not fit within any of the ten permissible reasons for convening in executive session.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
Release the November 4, 2021 executive session minutes to the public and to the Complainant, without any redaction.
Release any other HMA- or Workgroup-related executive session minutes that have not yet been released.
remedy_passage: Because the November 4, 2021, executive session was not properly held under the Open Meeting Law, we order the Council to release the minutes of that executive session to the public, and specifically to the Complainant.
